title: CI-12 conversation-eval runner gap
context: REQUIREMENTS section 12.2 specifies running every scenario as a live property eval. The installed claude CLI has 'plugin validate' but NO 'plugin eval' subcommand, and there is no documented live runner for ChatGPT/Codex (s2.yml and run_parity.py already say so). The machineable structural half of AC-20/CI-12 is covered by run_parity.py.

options.label: Automate the structural half via run_parity.py in CI; keep live property/conversational parity manual and recorded (honest, matches current docs)
Treat CI-12 as not done until a live property-eval runner exists (blocks S3 completion)

rationale: No live plugin-eval runner exists; automate structural half, keep live parity manual and recorded as docs already state
